name: ModelConflictPolicy
documentation:
Runtime behavior when a commit-scoped model changed after the commit's {@code readStateIndex}.

{@link #RETRY} is the default. Explicit {@link #ACCEPT} preserves the original decision: the original event is accepted, while stale derived documents, snapshots, and relationships are rebased by reapplying it to the latest values of the models actually read by the commit. Rejecting policies roll back the complete runtime commit; any retry is a new SDK evaluation against freshly loaded models.

methods.name: resolve
methods.documentation:
Resolves {@link #DEFAULT} to {@link #RETRY}. A missing wire value retains the legacy
 {@link #ACCEPT} interpretation; SDKs send their resolved policy explicitly.

enumConstants.name: ACCEPT
enumConstants.documentation: Accept the original event and silently rebase stale derived state. This is an explicit opt-in.

enumConstants.name: DEFAULT
enumConstants.documentation: Inherit from the next broader model-commit scope, falling back to {@link #RETRY}.

enumConstants.name: FAIL
enumConstants.documentation: Reject a stale commit and let the client map the conflict to an application decision.

enumConstants.name: RETRY
enumConstants.documentation: Reject a stale commit and permit a bounded complete reevaluation against freshly loaded models and relations.
